iso4217.csv.notes: Derived from list one. Excluded the 13 codes with minor unit N.A.: XAG, XAU, XBA, XBB, XBC, XBD, XDR, XPD, XPT, XSU, XTS, XUA, XXX. Kept the 10 fund codes (IsFund=true) because they denominate real instruments: BOV, CHE, CHW, CLF, COU, MXV, USN, UYI, UYW, XAD.
